definitions.explanation: The height of a person, measured from feet to head. The everyday way of referring to how tall someone is.

examples.japanese: {背|せ}の{高|たか}さはどのくらいですか。
{兄弟|きょうだい}でも{背|せ}の{高|たか}さがずいぶん{違|ちが}う。
examples.english: Even though they're brothers, their heights differ quite a bit.

examples.japanese: {背|せ}の{高|たか}さは{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}{頃|ごろ}にぐんと{伸|の}びる{子|こ}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many children's height shoots up around the time they're in middle school.

notes:
Literally "the tallness of one's back/torso." The everyday phrase; the single noun {身長|しんちょう} is more formal and used on forms and medical charts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さを{測|はか}る: to measure someone's height
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さが{違|ちが}う: heights differ
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さが{同|おな}じくらい: about the same height
- {背|せ}の{高|たか}さ{順|じゅん}に{並|なら}ぶ: to line up by height

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {身長|しんちょう}: height (formal) — used on forms, medical records, official descriptions
- {背|せ}が{高|たか}い: to be tall — the adjective expression, not the noun
- {背丈|せたけ}: stature — somewhat literary; emphasizes overall build
